description: This file contains extension methods for configuring streaming support in Orleans silos and clients, including registration of services related to streaming infrastructure, such as stream providers, subscription managers, and stream filters.

classes.name: StreamingServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Orleans streaming services in dependency injection.

methods.name: AddSiloStreaming
methods.description: Configures and registers services necessary for streaming support on an Orleans silo.

methods.name: AddClientStreaming
methods.description: Configures and registers services necessary for streaming support on an Orleans client.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter
methods.description: Registers a stream filter of a specified type and name into the service collection.
